name: Cabin Air Filter
summary: The E90 cabin microfilter is in the engine bay under the cowl at the base of the windshield (not behind the glovebox), confirmed by three sources. 8 mm socket confirmed by three. Fastener count is a CONFLICT (4 vs 6). Part numbers: 64319313519 (genuine BMW carbon, Turner only) and 64316946628 (two forum threads, now listed as superseded by Turner) are both in circulation; aftermarket 64319142115 also listed. The Bentley page indicates the cover procedure applies to E90/E91 built up to 12/2007, which suggests a possible production-date difference; the content (a video) could not be read. No torque specs, no airflow-arrow direction for E90 found.
variantDependencies: Production date: Bentley page title says applies to E90/E91 produced up to 12/2007; 2010 car is later, so cover/housing details may differ and are unconfirmed.
Filter type: plain pollen vs activated-carbon element; which one the car has from factory is unknown (Turner fitment covers both numbers).
Cowl-delete/cowl filter kits exist (aftermarket) and change the procedure; check whether the car has one.

parts.item: Pollen microfilter (older number, superseded per Turner)
parts.status: VERIFIED (BP1 and BP2 posters; Turner lists number as superseded and sells Hengst 64316946628BF/64316946629)

steps.title: Open hood and locate cover
steps.instruction: The microfilter housing is the long black plastic cover at the base of the windshield in the engine bay, in front of the wipers.

steps.title: Remove fasteners
steps.instruction: Remove the 8 mm screws securing the cover: BP2 says six total (two per duct for two air ducts, plus two through front tabs); BP1 also says six; BW says four 8 mm screws for the housing after removing the cover.
steps.status: CONFLICT (4 vs 6; likely differences in what counts)
warnings: Plastic threads strip easily; do not over-tighten. Do not drop screws into the cowl.

steps.title: Lift out assembly
steps.instruction: Lift the cover (or filter assembly) free of the cowl.

steps.title: Release and remove filter
steps.instruction: Press the retention tabs/clips and pull the old filter out. Note its orientation first; E90-specific arrow direction not found.
steps.status: VERIFIED (BW, BP2) for removal; orientation MISSING
warnings: Do not reinstall a dirty filter.

steps.title: Install new filter
steps.instruction: Seat the new filter fully in its frame/cover, confirm it sits flat and seals.

steps.title: Reassemble
steps.instruction: Refit cover, tighten all screws snugly, check seating and seal.

steps.title: Reset service reminder
steps.instruction: One poster describes holding the trip reset button, using the left stalk to scroll to the cabin-filter/fan icon, then holding the BC button to reset. Not confirmed for a 2010 car.

safety: Keep screws and debris out of the cowl drains and ducts.
Work with engine off and cool; wiper arms/cowl area is close.
missingEvidence: Cover removal details for post-12/2007 E90 (Bentley page unreadable).
Airflow direction arrow on the filter.
Factory filter type (pollen vs carbon) for this VIN.
